name: 小雨西游utf8
english_name: Light Rain Journey to the West (UTF-8 Snapshot)
english_description: Another independent archive of the Xiaoyu Xiyou / Xiaoyu Xiyou II engine, its filename flagging that it had already been pre-converted to UTF-8. Though it shares an engine family with this project's xyxy2 and xiaoyuxiyou snapshots -- including the same Aolai Kingdom newbie zone (safe sparring, an NPC-taught two-step skill-learning flow, a starting-inn shop and message board) -- a content-hash comparison shows it is not a byte-for-byte duplicate of either (8,753 vs. 11,149 .lpc files); it's a snapshot from a different point in the game's development, not just a re-encoding, so it was processed as its own distinct archive. Beyond the shared newbie content, this build layers a level-gated spell/dungeon progression under daemon/class/spells/40/, numbered in tiers players "break through" as they level.
